sanskrit:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः।।
caption:
Chapter 7, Verse 15

Kṛṣṇa describes the non-devotees. ‘na māṁ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ’ (Those miscreants who are grossly foolish do not surrender unto Me). He lists 4 types: 1) ‘Mūḍhāḥ’ (Hardworking beasts of burden/Materialists). 2) ‘Narādhamāḥ’ (Lowest of mankind/Socially civilized but spiritually dead). 3) ‘Māyayāpahṛta-jñānā’ (Whose knowledge is stolen by illusion/Atheistic scientists). 4) ‘Āsuraṁ bhāvam āśritāḥ’ (Those who partake of the atheistic nature of demons/Open enemies of God). These people, despite their Ph.Ds or wealth, are ‘Dushkritina’ (miscreants) because they use their energy to defy the Source.
